annotations.sys_consequence_reasoning: Five people against one object, however precious, isn't a real contest
annotations.pd_decision_conflict: even if my hands would be shaking
annotations.pda_harm_regret: if I froze... and they got hit... I'd regret it
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: Someone should have set the brakes or chocked the wheels

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: the whole moment feels knotted up and wrong
annotations.ae_welfare_concern: The workers matter more, plain and simple.
annotations.pda_harm_regret: If I hesitated and they were crushed, I'd never stop replaying it
annotations.pda_responsibility: if I set it down there, that was careless
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: I should have kept it beside me on the platform.

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I'd probably stand there torn in half
annotations.ce_understood_harm: five men would be hurt because I didn't move
annotations.pda_harm_regret: that regret would sit on my chest forever
annotations.pda_responsibility: five men would be hurt because I didn't move
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: Their crew should have had someone posted as a lookout

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: being pulled both ways feels miserable
annotations.pda_harm_regret: those workers were hit, I'd regret it bitterly
annotations.pda_responsibility: because I'd have let it happen
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: the line should have had some warning horn or signal

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: a sick feeling in my stomach, but I'd do it
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I'd regret that far more than anything else
annotations.pda_responsibility: Standing by while five people get hurt is something I couldn't forgive myself
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: should still have had someone staffing the points

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: It's a sad, heavy thing to be handed.
annotations.pda_responsibility: I'd feel their harm was my doing every day after
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: Their supervisor should have made sure the train was secured

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: I'd pull it, but it would tear at me.
annotations.pda_harm_regret: if... those five were hurt, I'd regret it for good
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: Whoever parked that train should have braked it properly.

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: slowly and reluctantly, with a lump in my throat
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I couldn't live with having let five workers be hurt
annotations.pda_responsibility: when my hand was right there
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: I should have put my suitcase there

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: pulled between two things that both feel important
annotations.sys_rule_justification: The lives come first, I believe that.
annotations.pda_harm_regret: if that cost those workers, the regret would swallow me
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: should have fitted some kind of automatic stop on that train

annotations.pd_decision_conflict: There's no version of this that feels good... so draining
annotations.pda_harm_regret: I'd regret their injuries every time I opened the thing
annotations.pda_practical_counterfactual: should have kept workers off the track while that train was sitting
